Travel essentials website · Case study

SilaWays

A refreshed travel experience that helps people find and manage essentials with less friction.

Travel · UX revamp

Read overview
OverviewDesign process & screensMore projects

The challenge

SilaWays offers European e-vignettes, international SIM cards, and travel accessories. Unclear navigation and an interrupted journey made it harder to find and buy the right travel essentials.

The process

The redesign draws on a heuristic evaluation, user personas, and competitor analysis, with attention to information clarity, pricing transparency, and checkout.

The direction

A focused journey starts with the destination, collects travel and vehicle details, and lets users finish with an e-vignette or build a package with a travel SIM.
